notes: Ludum Dare 56 game Sheeplings by JereNurminen (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/56/sheeplings). Complete Unity 6000.0.22f1 project with playable Level1–Level4 scenes in EditorBuildSettings (SampleScene left disabled). AGPL-3.0 at the repo-root LICENSE (standard GNU Affero GPLv3 text). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): 2D feature set (animation, Aseprite, pixel-perfect, PSD importer, sprite, SpriteShape, tilemap, tilemap extras), Input System 1.11.1, URP 17.0.3, Shader Graph, Timeline 1.8.7, uGUI, Visual Scripting 1.9.4, Multiplayer Center 1.0.0, collab-proxy, IDE packages, test framework, macOS/Linux toolchain, and built-in modules. No TextMesh Pro, no bundled fonts, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. macOS .DS_Store files were omitted. Sprites in Assets/ (including an original saw_rail.aseprite source) appear to be original jam art; the repository contains no third-party asset credits. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~11M src snapshot.
